test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

He says, “Some goods are of poor quality.”

options.text: He said that some goods were of poor quality.
He said that some goods are of poor quality.
He says that some goods are of poor quality.
He says that some goods were of poor quality.

solution:
The correct answer is **'He says that some goods are of poor quality.'**
